name: Cinematic brand spot (feeling → product)

hook.visual: One unforgettable image — motion, light, material
hook.text_overlay: None in first 3s if the image is strong
hook.pattern_interrupt: Beauty or tension that doesn’t look like a feed ad

beats.visual: 3–6 crafted shots with consistent grade and lens language
Hero object or process with same cinematic language

cta.landing_promise: Brand experience page, not a hard form first

audio_design.music_energy: Custom or licensed score; intentional dynamics

visual_system.camera: Locked-off or motivated moves; shallow DOF; anamorphic optional
visual_system.editing_pace: Breathing room; match cuts on motion

why_it_works: Builds brand memory for premium categories
Performs as organic + paid for storytelling brands
Differentiates from UGC-saturated auctions when targeting is warm
anti_patterns: Using cinematic style for a hard direct-response offer without proof
Inconsistent grade that breaks the spell
metrics_signals: Site engagement quality over raw CTR

prompt_seeds.script: 30s cinematic brand spot. Image-led hook. Mood world. Craft reveal. Soft end card.
prompt_seeds.video_gen: Cinematic shallow-DOF sequence, unified color grade, premium materials, no UI text overlays in first seconds

source_notes: Brand/TOFU pattern — not a substitute for DR creative in tight CAC accounts.
